summary: The Cow-side equality implementation compares the right-hand BStr's bytes with themselves, so unequal operands incorrectly compare equal. The fix compares those bytes with self.as_bytes(), restoring comparison between the two operands. The regression test added by the fix checks that Cow<BStr>("hello bstr") differs from &BStr("goodbye bstr").
expected_failure:
assertion failed: `(left != right)`
  left: `"hello bstr"`,
 right: `"goodbye bstr"`
